_note: The category of each rule's errors and warnings. A finding at note severity is a record whatever its rule. docs/rule-map.md defines the categories; scripts/gen-catalog.py checks that every rule is listed.

categories.safety: A physical hazard in the netlist as built: metastability with no resolution, a glitch or runt pulse, or a reset release that races its clock.
categories.protocol: Each bit is safely synchronized, but the transfer can deliver a value or an event sequence the source never produced: incoherent buses, reconvergence, lost events, missing handshakes.
categories.policy: A site-chosen threshold. The shape is safe; the verdict moves with a parameter such as sync_depth or the CDC-018 threshold.
categories.constraint: The clock or port typing a checker needs is missing or contradicts the netlist, so other verdicts on those endpoints cannot be trusted until it is fixed.
categories.record: An informational finding for review, at note severity. Never a violation; --ignore-notes drops it.
